prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain weight while maximizing performance for lightweight rowing competition in 3 days

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 1,800-2,000 calories distributed across 4-5 meals
Includes minimum 120g protein from allowed sources (poultry, fish, eggs, plant-based)
All meals are dairy-free and red meat-free
Plan is presented in compact format covering breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength gains and muscle recovery for powerlifting competition in 8 weeks

solution_criteria: Meal plan is compact and formatted for a single day

At least one meal is strategically timed within 2 hours post-training
Total daily caloric and macronutrient intake supports strength athlete goals
